description: This file defines a singleton object StringUtils that provides utility functions for string and linked list manipulations, specifically join and split operations, delegating to other utility classes.

classes.name: StringUtils
classes.description: Singleton object providing utility functions for string and linked list operations.

methods.name: join
methods.description: Concatenates elements of a LinkedList into a single String.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits a String into a LinkedList.
